design.baseline: 11 selected releases/16 channels at ca93aa3; retain exact Q.
design.donor_rule: Own source records and reviewed nominal settings, then shared stock, then preceding same-site/year/method evidence until an explicit protocol change; donor ages recorded without a fixed-day cutoff.
design.gain_assumption: Transferred K assumes compatible sensitivity; aliases are not identity evidence.
design.gap_models: Linear and endpoint-hold completions are sensitivity cases, not measured area or guaranteed bounds.
design.primary_promotion: None without resolving independent physical evidence.
design.selection: Retain alternatives; never select by Q similarity or R-squared alone.
design.volume_sensitivity: 12 and 12.9 L are explicit assumptions; 7.5% is not an uncertainty bound.
